articles.title: Portland's Adult Soap Box Derby: Where Gravity Meets Glitter and a Giant Sloth Head
articles.summary: A dragon car built from a kid's drawing, a Zamboni, and a giant sloth head all raced down an extinct volcano in Portland. The 27th Adult Soap Box Derby drew thousands for a celebration of creativity over speed.

articles.title: Mourinho's Low-Key Return to Real Madrid: A Closed-Door Homecoming
articles.summary: José Mourinho signed a contract until 2029 in a private ceremony, a stark contrast to Real Madrid's usual spectacle. The club, under pressure after two trophy-less years, is opting for discretion.

articles.title: Disney Sues FCC, Alleging Political Retaliation Over ABC's Coverage
articles.summary: Disney filed a lawsuit against the FCC, claiming the agency's early license review of eight ABC stations is retaliation for coverage that angered President Trump. Free speech advocates are praising the move.
